name: Athaliah
overview: Athaliah, the wife of King Jehoram and mother of Ahaziah, seized power in Judah by violently eliminating the royal lineage after her son's death, as described in 2 Kings 11:1. However, through the courageous actions of Jehosheba, the young Joash was hidden and preserved from her purge (2 Kings 11:2-3). After six years of Athaliah's reign, Joash was publicly crowned king in a God-ordained ceremony that provoked Athaliah's desperate outcry of treason (2 Kings 11:12-14). These events highlight God's providential preservation of His covenant line despite human wickedness.
